name: Linear Algebra
backbone_line: The backbone of this course is MIT OpenCourseWare 18.06SC Linear Algebra (Fall 2011, Prof. Gilbert Strang), published under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike licence. The wording of this Brief course is original to the Academy.
formula_phrase: write the actual matrices and equations: Ax = b with its row and column pictures, elimination to U, A = LU, the four subspaces with their dimensions, the normal equations AᵀAx̂ = Aᵀb, Ax = λx, A = XΛX⁻¹, S = QΛQᵀ and A = UΣVᵀ
drawings: two lines meeting at a point, three planes meeting, arrows combining tip to tail, a truss bridge with labelled joints, a staircase echelon form, a vector projected onto a plane with its perpendicular error, data points with a best-fit line, a circle stretched into an ellipse, a grayscale photograph rebuilt from a few layers, a handwritten matrix with a genuine pencil-and-paper look
names_example: ENGR 508 B, MIT 18.06SC, A = LU, the four fundamental subspaces, Gram-Schmidt, the singular value decomposition
